haikus.theme: National No Rhyme Nor Reason Day
haikus.haiku:
Bright soft snowflakes dance
Kids laugh, hearts glow, winter breeze
Joyful hush, stars gleam
Happy #NationalNoRhymeNorReasonDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Morning dew sparkles
Laughter echoes over hills
Joy fills warm bright air
Happy #EmmaMNuttDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Bright stars whisper light
Soft breeze hums through silver trees
Joy blooms like fresh dawn
#HappyBirthdayLilyTomlin from @ClamBakeSanta

Starlit night whispers
Old tales glow in bright soft blaze
Joyful pages turn
#HappyBirthdayEdgarRiceBurroughs from @ClamBakeSanta
